entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. My order number is VF88201. Can I return it or not?
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF88201. I see an order for the Pro-Series cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them?
They don't work for me. They caused massive blisters on my first ride. I just need to know if I can get a refund.
I'm sorry to hear about the blisters. Let me just check the return policy for you. I see the shoes were delivered 11 days ago.
Yes. So, can I return them?

Absolutely. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days. Since you're well within that window, I can process that full refund for you right away. You'll just need to send back the cycling shoes and the cleats that came with them.
Great. Finally, a simple answer. What do I do next?
I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. Just box everything up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help with?
